summary: Kole territory (Sankuru) covers Kole town, the territorial seat, and the Bena Dibele river port area along the Sankuru river, in a remote forest zone of central DRC. No armed group is known to hold territory there as of 2026; the Congolese state, chiefly through the PNC, is the main coercive actor, with ANR and small FARDC elements in Kole town. Rural areas have thin PNC presence and rely heavily on customary chiefs, and insecurity stems mostly from banditry and local disputes. Live web research was unavailable in this run (search budget exhausted, search engines blocked), so the assessment rests on background knowledge and the default-state-presence rule.
